title: QUSX-Audio surah index
description: Maps QUSX global word ids to audio clips and the text they speak.

qusxAudio.description: Spec version this file conforms to.

language.description: BCP-47 or ISO 639 code for the spoken language, e.g. 'en', 'ur'.

kind.description: word-gloss = spoken translation; recitation = Qur'anic Arabic.

layoutAgnostic.description: True when the ids are valid across every QUSX print layout. Set false and name the layout if that cannot be guaranteed.

qusxLayout.description: Layout the ids were derived from. Required when layoutAgnostic is false.

words.description: QUSX word id (as a decimal string) -> clip id. Ids absent from this map have no audio, which includes every type="number" token.

text.description: Clip id -> the gloss as printed, with any brackets the source uses to mark translator-supplied words. Keyed by clip rather than by position so a repeated word is stored once.

spoken.description: Clip id -> what the audio actually says, present only where it differs from `text` (brackets cannot be pronounced, so they are folded away for synthesis). Absent key means the audio matches `text` exactly.
